src: Hi, I'm Ravichandra, a Senior Multi-Cloud DevOps Engineer. For the last ten years, I've been building and running production platforms on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. I design CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, GitHub Actions and GitLab. I run containers on Kubernetes, EKS, AKS and OpenShift. I build everything as code, with Terraform and Ansible. And I keep it all observable, with Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry and CloudWatch. Come, let me walk you through my journey.
